headline: On last trading day, Sensex crashed 876 points; Indian stock markets remain closed today for Dussehra.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: Indian stock exchanges BSE and NSE are closed today, October 20, 2026, on account of Dussehra.
Trading across equity, derivatives, and SLB segments is suspended for the market holiday.
On the last trading day (October 19), Sensex crashed 876.37 points to settle at 73,852.90.
Nifty 50 dropped 1.11% in the previous session to close at 22,888.95, led down by banking and IT stocks.
whatHappening: Normal stock market trading will resume on Wednesday, October 21, 2026.
HFCL doubled its FY27 revenue growth target after reporting a strong Q2 performance.
Tonbo Imaging's Rs 852 crore IPO closed with a massive subscription of 140 times.
India and New Zealand's Free Trade Agreement came into force, offering zero-duty access for key exports.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today, October 20, for the Dussehra holiday, with trading set to resume on Wednesday. On the last trading day, benchmarks saw a sharp sell-off with Sensex tumbling 876 points and Nifty dropping 1.11%. Key corporate news highlights HFCL doubling its FY27 revenue growth target after strong Q2 results.
